tasks.answer: Use discussions.DeleteDiscussion, the destructive confirmation control for deleting a discussion; pass the discussion id. It is wrapped in an admin Authorization check, so render it inside an authenticated route.

The login form uses ui.form.Input. It binds react-hook-form through the required registration prop (Partial<UseFormRegisterReturn>), e.g. registration={register('email')}; label and error come from FieldWrapper, so use it inside a Form.

The discussions-list pagination control is ui.table.TablePagination (Table renders it when given a pagination prop). Table pagination requires totalPages, currentPage and rootUrl; links use rootUrl?page=N, so rootUrl must not contain a query string.
Safe Markdown body rendering uses ui.md-preview.MDPreview; its input prop is value, a Markdown string that is sanitized with DOMPurify (do not pass pre-rendered HTML).
Creating a discussion uses discussions.CreateDiscussion, an admin-only drawer form: only admins see the trigger and it requires the Authorization provider. It takes no required props.

notes: All five answers resolved via catalog search/get only; no project source files were read. The catalog marks Input's registration prop schema as unsupported but documents the react-hook-form requirement and FieldWrapper behavior. Pagination ID was found via targeted 'TablePagination'/'table pagination' search.
